title: Morning Brief — Friday, 9 October 2026
description: The new AusAlert emergency warning system and federal funding for 100,000 new homes, Rockhampton's Customs House conservation project and a new round of Destination 2045 ecotourism funding, plus fresh figures on the Gold Coast's fast-outpacing population growth. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
